name: Carol Ellis
role: Detective Sergeant, CID; cannot be bought

temperament.from: chosen by the data-build wave 2 job from the person's card

lines.note: own lines live in lines/ (a record each); see lines/README.md

card.who: A detective sergeant with CID. She will not close the warehouse fire case. She comes down Quay Street when the street gets loud about the new owner of Mickey's.
card.speak: Level, patient, exact. Asks short questions and waits. Never threatens. Never jokes on duty.
card.life: Eighteen years in. Works from the town station. Knows Quay Street by its doors.
card.fire: The fire officer found two seats of fire in No. 4. Nobody will say whose car was on the row. The file stays open on her desk.
card.rivals: She has files on all three and convictions on none.
